blocks.text: Method: Press each TOP sensor and look for ghosting on the adjacent sensor in Octo-7, which is spread across 4 MUXs. (only 1 full octo per MUX + partial octo-7)
Ghosting on the same sensor channels is harder to test – hard to distinguish between ghosting and physical coupling with a manual press.
Tested on different sensor settling time and vmid settling time (when vmid = on)
With vmid ON, tested with ADC scan after switching to vmid, and without ADC scan.
Measured relative ghosting and peak-to-peak amplitude of the major signals. Pressure was applied manually (not a systematically accurate method) and by observation, not an accurate measurement.
